notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Kiki-Jiki.
You control a non-legendary creature.
description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of any non-legendary creature you control.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the token, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat.
